D/ DN VALENS PF AVG ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBL[ICAE] ; R/ SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE ; D/ D N GRATIAN VS [AVGG AVG] ; R/ GLORIA RO[MA]NORVM ; D/ D N GRATI[AN VS AVGG] AVG ; R/ GLORIA [ROMANORV]M ; D/ DN VALEN [SPF AVG] ; R/ [GLORIA ROMANORVM] ; D/ [IMP C TETRICVS P F AVG] ; R/ P[A]X AVG ; D/ DN VAL[EN S]PF

A group of nine Roman nummi dating from AD367-375 and two radiate coins dating from AD271-274. These coins were found dispersed in the same area. 1. A Roman copper alloy nummus of Valens, SECVRITAS REI PVBLICAE reverse depicting Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Mint of Lyons, AD 367-75 (Reece period 19). RIC volume IX,. Dimensions: diameter: 17.60mm; weight: 2.32g. Denomination: Nummus (AE 1 - AE 4). Ruler/issuer: Valens. Reece period: Period 19 [364-378]. Mint or issue place: Lugdunum. Obverse description: Diademed, draped cuirassed bust right. Obverse inscription: DN VALENS PF AVG. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription:…
